items.title: Seminoles Take Down Pitt for Second Straight Road Win
items.summary: PITTSBURGH – The Florida State football team (5-5, 3-4 ACC) defeated Pitt (6-4, 3-4 ACC) 16-10 Friday night at Acrisure Stadium, earning its second consecutive road win.

items.title: Thomas, Chaplin Named ACC Players of the Week
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – 5th Year left tackle Xavier Chaplin and freshman running back Amari Thomas earned ACC Player of the Week recognition Monday after helping lead FSU to a 31-24 victory at Boston College.

items.title: FSU vs. NC State Set for 3:30 PM on November 21
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – Florida State will host NC State on Nov. 21 at 3:30 PM, it was announced Monday. The game will air on ACC Network from Doak Campbell Stadium.

items.title: Seminoles Battle Past Boston College for Road Victory
items.summary: CHESTNUT HILL, Mass. – The Florida State football team (4-5, 2-4 ACC) defeated Boston College (4-5, 2-4 ACC) 31-24 on Saturday afternoon at Alumni Stadium.

items.title: Florida State Makes Football Leadership Change
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. — Florida State University President Richard McCullough informed head football coach Mike Norvell Sunday afternoon that FSU is making a change in the leadership of its football program, effective immediately. FSU Athletics Hall of Fame member Rick Stockstill has been named interim head coach.

items.title: Seminoles Fall to Clemson
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – The Florida State football team (3-5, 1-4 ACC) fell to Clemson (5-3, 3-2 ACC) 36-24 Saturday evening at Doak Campbell Stadium.

items.summary: IRVING, Texas (Oct. 26, 2026) – Florida State and the National Football Foundation (NFF) & College Hall of Fame announced today that they will jointly honor 2026 NFF College Football Hall of Fame electee Peter Warrick with an NFF Hall of Fame On-Campus Salute, presented by Fidelity Investments. items.title: FSU at Boston College Set for Noon on November 7
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – Florida State will play at Boston College on November 7 at 12:00 p.m., it was announced Monday. The game will air on ACC Network.

items.title: Florida State Reveals Elevated Game Day Experience for October 31 Contest in Doak Campbell Stadium
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – The Florida State athletics department announced on Friday an elevated game day experience for the football team's October 31 home contest against Clemson. Fans will experience an entire day of celebrating our nation's military, FSU legend Peter Warrick, a variety of Halloween-themed elements and unforgettable stadium presentations.

items.title: Robinson Named Campbell Trophy Finalist
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – Florida State senior wide receiver Duce Robinson is a finalist for the William V. Campbell Trophy, college football's premier scholar-athlete award that "recognizes an individual as the absolute best in the nation for his combined academic success, football performance and exemplary leadership."
